svg.title: Riju removes his hidden anomaly notebook from the satchel.
svg.desc: A thin notebook emerges from beneath orderly launch forms in Riju's satchel. He opens it to the unresolved cases and admits that he excluded their count from the launch measure.
svg.text: Page 54, panel 3 · Tight shot on Riju opening the hidden notebook

text.tspan: Riju admits that he hid the scale of the anomalies.
